business_summary: Yinchuan Xinhua Commercial (Group) Co., Ltd. engages in commercial retail, logistics, and commercial property leasing businesses in China. The company operates department stores, shopping malls, supermarket chains, and electronics and telecommunication chains. It offers its products under the Xinbai Department Store, Xinbai Supermarket, and Xinbai Electrical Appliances brand names. The company was formerly known as Yinchuan Xinhua Department Store Co., Ltd. Yinchuan Xinhua Commercial (Group) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Yinchuan, China.
business_summary_ko: Yinchuan Xinhua Commercial (Group) Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 상업용 소매, 물류 및 상업용 부동산 임대 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 백화점, 쇼핑몰, 슈퍼마켓 체인, 전자 및 통신 체인을 운영하고 있습니다. Xinbai 백화점, Xinbai 슈퍼마켓 및 Xinbai Electrical Appliances 브랜드 이름으로 제품을 제공합니다. 이 회사의 이전 명칭은 Yinchuan Xinhua Department Store Co., Ltd. Yinchuan Xinhua Commercial (Group) Co., Ltd.는 1997년에 설립되었으며 중국 인촨에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
